title: The Arithmetic Geometry of Square-Sided Heron Triangles
summary: We study rational Heron triangles with two marked square sides using elliptic curves and K3 surfaces. An explicit quartic-to-elliptic correspondence parametrizes marked similarity classes by rational points satisfying a positivity condition, modulo \((x,y)\sim(x,-y)\). We determine the generic Mordell--Weil group, prove that every \(k\in\mathbf Q\setminus\{0,\pm1\}\) supports infinitely many scalene classes with exactly two square sides, and construct a primitive family with \(N(X)\gg X^{1/4}\).
